messages.content: 這家企業的營收為15000美元，總成本為22000美元，回報率是多少？

function.name: investment_analysis_calculate_profit
function.description: Calculates the net profit given the total revenue and total cost Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

total_revenue.description: The total revenue for the business. This is a float type value.

total_cost.description: The total cost for the business. This is a float type value.

message.content:
營收為 15,000 美元，總成本為 22,000 美元，先算出淨利：

\[
\text{淨利} = \text{營收} - \text{成本} = 15{,}000 - 22{,}000 = -7{,}000 \text{ 美元}
\]

淨利率（Return on Sales）＝淨利 ÷ 營收：

\[
\text{淨利率} = \frac{-7{,}000}{15{,}000} \approx -0.4667 \;(\text{或 } -46.67\%)
\]

也就是說，這家公司在這段期間內的營收回報率為 **-46.7%**，表示營收不足以覆蓋成本，造成虧損。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "這家企業的營收為15000美元，總成本為22000美元，回報率是多少？" They want the return rate. Return rate likely means net profit / total revenue? Or net profit margin? They gave revenue and cost. Net profit = revenue - cost = -7000. Return rate maybe net profit / revenue = -7000/15000 = -0.4667 or -46.67%. Alternatively return on investment (ROI) = net profit / cost? That would be -7000/22000 = -0.318 = -31.8%. But typical return rate is net profit margin: net profit / revenue. So answer: -46.7%. We can compute using function? There's a function to calculate profit but not return rate. We can compute manually. Provide answer in Chinese.
